Upgrade your kitchen with the Kenwood 18 Cu Ft (480-Liter) Inverter Refrigerator. Featuring a stunning Maroon Glass Door (GD MRG) finish, this high-capacity fridge is powered by an advanced SECOP Inverter compressor, delivering up to 60% energy savings. Designed for Pakistani power grids, it operates safely with a 110V low-voltage startup and features 100% copper wiring for maximum durability. Premium Aesthetics &

\n

Make a bold statement in your kitchen with the Kenwood KRF-Invertech-26657 Glass Door Refrigerator. Boasting an elegant Maroon Glass (MRG) finish, this 18 Cubic Foot (480-Liter) powerhouse combines luxurious design with cutting-edge cooling technology. At its core is the highly reliable SECOP Inverter compressor, which dynamically adjusts its cooling output to provide up to 60% energy savings, slashing your monthly electricity bills without compromising on performance.

\n

Keep your groceries fresher for longer. This model is equipped with a specialized internal UV Light that actively eliminates bacteria, ensuring a healthier storage environment for your family. Built specifically for local electrical conditions, it features 100% pure copper wiring and a 110V low-voltage startup, meaning your refrigerator will continue to run safely and efficiently even during severe power drops—no external stabilizer required. Furthermore, the use of eco-friendly R600A refrigerant ensures rapid, highly efficient cooling.

\n
  • UV Light Protection: Built-in UV technology keeps the internal environment hygienic and bacteria-free.

\n
  • 100% Copper Wiring: Superior build quality ensures faster cooling and a significantly longer appliance lifespan.
